The best narrative source adds Santa Monica, but no second personal identifier links this historical buyer to a distinct public biography. The evidence therefore remains below 75 rather than attaching one of many Louis Black namesakes.

Sources consistently describe Caribbean or Turks and Caicos treasure hunting, and one later sailing history names the Atocha. They do not document a successful recovery, commercial salvage enterprise, licence, partners or financial result.
